title: Low-capacitance pulsed discharge enables heat- and solvent-free delamination of lithium-ion battery cathodes
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00304K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chiharu Tokoro, Moe Nakahara, Takatoshi Kurihara, Akiko Kubota, Mauricio Córdova-Udaeta, Asako Narita, Yutaro Takaya
A low-capacitance pulsed discharge induces rapid interfacial heating, achieving >99% delamination of Li-ion battery cathodes while minimizing Al contamination to <0.2 wt%.
